nodes.name: Gemini Fallback — Chat Model
nodes.notes: FALLBACK: Connect this node's output to the LLM Chain 'ai_languageModel' input as a fallback. n8n tries primary model first; if it fails, it uses fallback models in order.

nodes.name: Google Gemini Embeddings
nodes.notes: text-embedding-004 → 768 dimensions. Connected via ai_embedding to the Generate Embedding HTTP node below. Since n8n embedding sub-nodes are designed for vector stores, we use the raw Gemini API call below but keep this node for visual architecture clarity.

nodes.name: Generate Embedding — Gemini API
nodes.notes: Calls Gemini REST API directly with $env.GEMINI_API_KEY (env vars work in HTTP Request nodes). Returns { embedding: { values: number[768] } }.

llm_chain.fallback_mechanism: LLM Chain error output → Gemini HTTP fallback → Merge node

embeddings.api_call: HTTP Request → Gemini text-embedding-004 REST API

credentials_required: openAiApi credential with DeepSeek API key → replace REPLACE_WITH_DEEPSEEK_CREDENTIAL_ID
